We coordinate the ferry crossing as part of your move — no action needed on your part, but it does add 10–22 days to the overall timeline. Victoria's Mild Climate Is Year-Round Moving Friendly Victoria has the mildest climate in Canada. Unlike Toronto, you won't face extreme cold or heavy snowfall. However, summer ferry traffic is heavy — book early if moving June through August. Plan Your BC Health and Driver Documentation Apply for BC's Medical Services Plan (MSP) immediately upon arrival — there is a 3-month waiting period. You also have 90 days to exchange your Ontario driver's licence for a BC licence at an ICBC driver licensing office. Parking and Access in Victoria Victoria's older neighbourhoods often have narrow streets and limited parking for large moving trucks. Let us know your address in advance so we can plan the best access route and equipment. Nanaimo as an Alternative to Victoria Nanaimo is a growing city on Vancouver Island with lower housing costs than Victoria. If you're still deciding between the two, note that both are served by BC Ferries from Tsawwassen or Horseshoe Bay.
